_readme: Keys are prefab Name or Prefab string from LilithsMind PrefabDef entries (e.g. 'BloodEssence' or 'Item_BloodEssence_T01'). All appearance fields apply when non-null. Files in Items/ load alphabetically and merge per-field — later files win on conflicts.
_appearance_readme: DisplayName sets the item name shown in tooltips and inventory. DescriptionText sets the tooltip body. Icon can be: (1) a PNG filename in the client Icons/ folder e.g. 'vitae.png'; (2) an in-game sprite name e.g. 'Icon_BloodOrb'; (3) an https:// URL the client will download and cache.
_changesEnabled_readme: ChangesEnabled gates functional fields (StackSize and future additions). Appearance fields always apply when non-null regardless of ChangesEnabled.

Item_BloodEssence_T01.DescriptionText: Concentrated life force, harvested from the living.
